doc.title: Mess Management (Unavailable Functionality)
doc.summary: This document outlines several functionalities currently unavailable within the Digii Mess Management module. It details limitations regarding the deletion of added messes, viewing past or future meal menus, personal meal consumption tracking for students and staff, the ability to add or modify previous meal menus, and options for users to select preferred meals to reduce wastage.

chunks.what_it_does: Currently, the platform allows mess administrators to add or modify mess details but does not provide an option to delete a mess once created.
chunks.why_it_matters: This restriction prevents the removal of outdated or unused mess data from the platform, leading to potential data clutter and inaccuracy if a mess is no longer operational or has been converted.

chunks.feature_name: Limited Meal Menu Viewing (Current Day Only)
chunks.what_it_does: The platform currently only displays meal menus for the current day, lacking functionality to view future or past meal schedules.
chunks.why_it_matters: This limitation restricts students and staff from planning meals, reduces transparency regarding upcoming or previous meal options, and can lead to missed meals or food wastage due to insufficient information.

chunks.feature_name: Student and Staff Meal Consumption Tracking
chunks.what_it_does: Currently, only mess administrators can generate reports on meal consumption, and students or staff do not have the ability to check their own meal consumption history.
chunks.why_it_matters: This lack of a personal meal consumption tab for students and staff reduces transparency, prevents self-management of meal tracking, and makes it difficult for individuals to verify their meal access or entitlement.

chunks.feature_name: Inability to Add or Modify Previous Meal Menus
chunks.what_it_does: The platform currently only allows mess administrators to add future meal menus and does not support the addition or modification of previous meal menus.
chunks.why_it_matters: This limitation restricts flexibility, making it impossible to correct, update, or retroactively add meal details for past dates, which can lead to inaccurate or incomplete historical meal records for reporting purposes.

chunks.what_it_does: The platform displays the meal menu per meal type but does not allow individual members (students or staff) to select their preferred meals.
chunks.why_it_matters: This leads to potential food wastage as members may be served meals they do not want or need, and it prevents personalization, making it harder for mess administrators to match meal quantities with actual demand and promote a sustainable meal system.
